camel_example: aliyun sgw UpdateGatewayFileShare --region cn-hangzhou --IndexId NFStest --GatewayId 'gw-000c6hshwukkbryp0000' --Name name
description_en: This operation updates the configuration of a file share for a file gateway
description_zh: 在文件网关下更新文件共享配置
kebab_example: aliyun sgw update-gateway-file-share --gateway-id gw-000c6hshwukkbryp0000 --index-id NFStest --name name --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateGatewayFileShare

parameters.help_en: The ID of the gateway
parameters.help_zh: 网关ID
parameters.name: gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the file share. Call the DescribeGatewayFileShares operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 文件共享ID。可以通过DescribeGatewayFileShares接口获得
parameters.name: index_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the file share. Call the DescribeGatewayFileShares operation to obtain the name. This parameter cannot be modified
parameters.help_zh: 文件共享名称。可以通过DescribeGatewayFileShares接口获得。不支持修改
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable remote sync for the file share. Valid values:

false (default): No.

true: Yes
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享是否打开反向同步。取值范围如下：

false（默认）：否。

true：是
parameters.name: remote_sync

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to download file data in replication mode. This parameter is available for file gateways that run version 1.2.0 or later. Valid values:

false (default): No.

true: Yes.

This parameter is valid only when remote sync is enabled for the file share or the file share is added to an express synchronization group
parameters.help_zh:
复制模式情况下，是否下载文件数据。网关版本1.2.0及以上支持此参数。取值范围如下：

false（默认）：否。

true：是。

只有当该共享打开了反向同步或者加入极速同步组时候，这个参数才生效
parameters.name: remote_sync_download

parameters.help_en:
The remote sync interval, in seconds. This parameter is required if you enable remote sync. Valid values: 15 to 36000.

If the file share is in replication mode and remote sync is enabled to download file data, the valid values are 3600 to 36000
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享反向同步时间间隔。单位秒，在启用反向同步情况下必传。取值范围为15~36000。

在复制模式和反向同步启用下载文件数据时，取值范围为3600~36000
parameters.name: polling_interval

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to ignore file deletions. If this feature is enabled, deleting a file on the gateway does not delete the corresponding file in OSS. Valid values:

false (default): No.

true: Yes.

This parameter is available for file gateways that run version 1.0.40 or later
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享是否忽略删除。启用后网关侧删除文件不会删除云上(OSS)对应文件。取值范围如下：

false（默认）：否。

true：是。

网关版本1.0.40及以上支持此参数
parameters.name: ignore_delete

parameters.help_en: The maximum write speed of the file share, in MB/s. Valid values: 0 to 1280. A value of 0 indicates no limit
parameters.help_zh: 文件共享最大写入速度，单位为MB/s。取值范围为0~1280，0为默认值，表示无限制
parameters.name: frontend_limit

parameters.help_en:
The maximum upload speed of the file share, in MB/s. Valid values: 0 to 1280. A value of 0 indicates no limit.

If you also set FrontendLimit, the value of BackendLimit cannot be less than the value of FrontendLimit
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享最大上传速度，单位为MB/s。0代表无限制。取值范围为0~1280，0为默认值，表示无限制。

如果同时已限制最大写入速度，最大上传速度不能小于最大写入速度
parameters.name: backend_limit

parameters.help_en:
The maximum download speed of the file share, in MB/s. Valid values: 0 to 12800. A value of 0 indicates no limit. This parameter can be set only if the file share is in replication mode and file data download is enabled. This parameter is available for file gateways that run version 1.3.0 or later.

This parameter is valid only when remote sync is enabled for the file share or the file share is added to an express synchronization group
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享最大下载速度，单位为MB/s。取值范围为0~12800，0表示无限制，只在复制模式且开启下载文件数据时才可设置。网关版本1.3.0及以上支持此参数。
只有当该共享打开了反向同步或者加入极速同步组时，此参数才生效
parameters.name: download_limit

parameters.help_en: This parameter is deprecated. Do not set this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 已废弃，不建议设置
parameters.name: in_place

parameters.help_en: The cache mode of the file share. Call the DescribeGatewayFileShares operation to obtain the cache mode. This parameter cannot be modified
parameters.help_zh: 文件共享缓存模式。可以通过DescribeGatewayFileShares接口获得。不支持修改
parameters.name: cache_mode

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the file share is browsable over the SMB protocol. A browsable file share can be discovered in Network Neighborhood. Valid values:

true (default): Yes.

false: No.

This parameter is invalid for the NFS protocol
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享SMB协议下是否可浏览（即网络邻居中是否可发现）。取值范围如下：

true（默认）：是。

false：否。


该参数在NFS协议下无效
parameters.name: browsable

parameters.help_en:
The user mapping for the file share over the NFS protocol. The default value is none. Valid values:

none

root_squash

all_squash

all_anonymous
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享NFS协议下用户映射，默认值为none。取值范围如下：

none。

root_squash。

all_squash。

all_anonymous
parameters.name: squash

parameters.help_en:
The list of users who have read and write permissions on the file share over the SMB protocol. Separate multiple users with commas (,).

This parameter is invalid for the NFS protocol
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享SMB协议下读写用户列表。多个用户使用“,”分隔。

该参数在NFS协议下无效
parameters.name: read_write_user_list

parameters.help_en:
The list of users who have read-only permissions on the file share over the SMB protocol. Separate multiple users with commas (,).

This parameter is invalid for the NFS protocol
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享SMB协议下只读用户列表。多个用户使用“,”分隔。

该参数在NFS协议下无效
parameters.name: read_only_user_list

parameters.help_en: The list of clients that have read and write permissions on the file share over the NFS protocol. The clients can be IP addresses or IP address ranges. Separate multiple clients with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 文件共享NFS协议下读写客户端列表（可以是IP地址或者IP地址范围)。多个客户端使用“,”分隔
parameters.name: read_write_client_list

parameters.help_en: The list of clients that have read-only permissions on the file share over the NFS protocol. The clients can be IP addresses or IP address ranges. Separate multiple clients with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 文件共享NFS协议下只读客户端列表（可以是IP地址或者IP地址范围）。多个客户端使用“,”分隔
parameters.name: read_only_client_list

parameters.help_en:
The synchronization latency, in seconds. This is the delay for synchronizing the gateway's local cache with OSS. Valid values: 5 to 120. The default value is 5.

This parameter is available for file gateways that run version 1.0.40 or later
parameters.help_zh:
同步延迟，即网关本地缓存同步到云上OSS的延迟时间。单位为秒。取值范围为5~120，5为默认值。


网关版本1.0.40及以上支持此参数
parameters.name: lag_period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable Direct I/O (DirectIO) for data transfer on the file share. Valid values:

false (default): No.

true: Yes
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享是否启用DirectIO（直接I/O方式进行数据传输）。取值范围如下：

false（默认）：否。

true：是
parameters.name: direct_io

parameters.help_en: Deprecated
parameters.help_zh: 废弃
parameters.name: server_side_encryption

parameters.help_en: Deprecated
parameters.help_zh: 废弃
parameters.name: server_side_cmk

parameters.help_en: Deprecated
parameters.help_zh: 废弃
parameters.name: client_side_encryption

parameters.help_en: Deprecated
parameters.help_zh: 废弃
parameters.name: client_side_cmk

parameters.help_en: Deprecated
parameters.help_zh: 废弃
parameters.name: kms_rotate_period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable upload optimization for the file share. This feature is suitable for scenarios where data is only backed up to the cloud. Valid values:

false (default): No.

true: Yes.

This parameter is available for file gateways that run version 1.0.39 or later
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享是否开启上传优化，适合数据纯备份上云场景。取值范围如下：

false（默认）：否。

true：是。

网关版本1.0.39及以上支持此参数
parameters.name: fast_reclaim

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable access control through a Windows access control list (ACL) over the SMB protocol. This feature requires an Active Directory (AD) domain. Valid values:

false (default): No.

true: Yes.

This parameter is available for file gateways that run version 1.0.45 or later
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享SMB协议下，是否开启通过Windows访问列表（需要AD域）进行权限控制。取值范围如下：

false（默认）：否。

true：是。

网关版本1.0.45及以上支持此参数
parameters.name: windows_acl

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable Windows access-based enumeration (ABE) over the SMB protocol. This parameter takes effect only when the \`WindowsAcl\` parameter is set to \`true\`. Valid values:

false (default): No.

true: Yes.

This parameter is available for file gateways that run version 1.0.45 or later
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享SMB协议下，是否启用Windows ABE。需要windowsAcl参数设置为true情况下生效。取值范围如下：

false（默认）：否。

true：是。


网关版本1.0.45及以上支持此参数
parameters.name: access_based_enumeration

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable NFSv4 optimization to improve mount and upload efficiency over the NFS protocol. Valid values:

false (default): No.

true: Yes.

After you enable this feature, you cannot mount the file share using NFSv3. This parameter is available for file gateways that run version 1.2.0 or later
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享NFS协议下，是否启用NFS v4优化，提升挂载上传效率。取值范围如下：

false（默认）：否。

true：是。


开启后将不支持NFS v3形式挂载，网关版本1.2.0及以上支持此参数
parameters.name: nfs_v4_optimization

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable transfer acceleration for the file share. The corresponding OSS bucket must also have transfer acceleration enabled.

This parameter is available for file gateways that run version 1.3.0 or later
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享是否开启传输加速功能，需要对应OSS Bucket已开启传输加速。


网关版本1.3.0及以上支持此参数
parameters.name: transfer_acceleration

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable direct OSS reads for the file share. If enabled, data is read directly from OSS without passing through the gateway cache. Valid values:

false (default): No.

true: Yes.

This feature is not recommended for most use cases
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享是否启用直读OSS功能，不通过网关缓存直接读OSS数据。取值范围如下：

false（默认）：否。

true：是。


不建议开启此功能
parameters.name: bypass_cache_read

parameters.help_en: Deprecated
parameters.help_zh: 废弃
parameters.name: server_side_algorithm

Code.description_zh: 状态码。状态码为200表示请求成功
